$comment: IA of the vadimcarazan.com experience rebuild (placeholder content). Routes come from src/main.jsx (two route shapes) and the 15 case-study projects in src/engine/data.js, slugged with the app's own slugify(). Sections were read from src/App.jsx, src/components/*, src/pages/CaseStudy.jsx and src/index.css / src/case.css.

meta.source: Local rebuild of https://vadimcarazan.com (React + Vite + three.js, placeholder content), served by `npm run dev`

categories.SHELL: Fixed chrome and runtime utility layers: top bar, loader, menus, hover label, toast, fades.
categories.STAGE: The full-viewport visual stage behind the UI: the WebGL portrait cosmos and the signature drawn behind it.
categories.NAV: In-page wayfinding that moves you through the work: the fly-through caption bar, the next-case link.
categories.PANEL: Views inside the glass box that opens over the cosmos (project, selected work, about).
categories.CONTENT: Body blocks of a case-study page: cover, prose, images, pairs, video.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to start a project: the CTA card and the contact brief.

stage.signature.description: Hand-drawn pen line behind the canvas, drawn in 2.9 s after the intro with a nib glow, masked with an elliptical hole around the portrait's head; hidden while flying or while the glass box is open.

stage.cosmos.description: Full-viewport WebGL field of work tiles: forms the halftone portrait at rest, flies the camera forward on scroll/keys/touch through an endless stream with a central lane of works, hover-picks and click-opens a work, blurs and reframes beside the glass box.

shell.fly-fades.description: Top and bottom dark gradient bands over the stage that fade in once the camera is flying, so the top bar and fly bar stay legible.
shell.fly-fades.scope: Only the cosmos home route, and only in the flying state.

shell.topbar.description: Fixed top row: logo mark (home), 'Currently' and 'Based in' fact columns with a live clock, and the Selected / Work / About / Contact navigation; collapses to a 'Menu' word at 860 px and below.
shell.topbar.scope: Every route: the cosmos home and all case-study pages.

shell.mobile-menu.description: Phone-only glass panel opened by the 'Menu' word: four large serif links, the intro lead and the two fact columns.
shell.mobile-menu.scope: Only the cosmos home route, at 860 px and below.

hero.cosmos-intro.description: Bottom-anchored intro over the portrait: a three-line lead, the 'Explore the work' pill with a bobbing arrow, and the full-bleed serif name; slides away once you fly in or a box opens.

shell.social.description: Bottom-right 'Elsewhere' link list, visible only while the About or Contact view is open; lifts above the fly bar when flying.
shell.social.scope: Only the cosmos home route, desktop only.

nav.flybar.description: Bottom bar while flying: the zero-padded number, title and kind of the next lane piece (click opens it), an 'N of M works' seen counter, and the 'Back to home' pill that rewinds to the portrait.
nav.flybar.scope: Only the cosmos home route, in the flying state.

panel.project.description: Glass-box view for one work: Close / Copy link / 'Read the case study' header, kind line, serif title, description, the piece and the rest of its set in a vertical gallery, then the CTA card.
panel.project.scope: Only the cosmos home route, when a work is opened (click, fly bar, or ?work=).

panel.selected.description: Glass-box view listing the first eight case studies as numbered rows with a thumbnail; a row flies the camera to that work and opens it.
panel.selected.scope: Only the cosmos home route (nav 'Selected' or ?open=selected).

panel.about.description: Glass-box about view: serif statement, two body paragraphs, a two-column facts grid (selected clients as fly-to buttons, counts, elsewhere, contact) and the CTA card pinned to the bottom.
panel.about.scope: Only the cosmos home route (nav 'About', fact columns, or ?open=about).

conversion.contact-brief.description: Glass-box project brief form: name, email, company, 'What do you need?' checkbox chips, budget radio chips, message, submit pill and a mailto note; swaps to a thank-you block on send.
conversion.contact-brief.scope: Only the cosmos home route (nav 'Contact', any 'Start a project', or ?open=contact).

conversion.cta-card.description: Gradient-lit card: 'Have something in mind?' kicker, serif line, a white 'Start a project' pill and one underlined secondary link.
conversion.cta-card.scope: The cosmos home route (inside the project and about views) and every case-study page (after the body).
conversion.cta-card.implementedBy: src/components/Box.jsx > Cta; duplicated inline in src/pages/CaseStudy.jsx

shell.hover-hud.description: Small dark pill with the hovered work's title, following the pointer 14 px above it; desktop pointer only.
shell.hover-hud.implementedBy: src/App.jsx > .hud (positioned by the engine's hover hook)

shell.loader.description: Full-screen loader whose two-stroke mark draws itself with real load progress, then fades out to start the intro.
shell.loader.scope: Only the cosmos home route, on first load.

shell.copy-toast.description: White 'Link copied' pill that rises at the bottom centre for 1.8 s after Copy link.

shell.page-top-fade.description: Permanent dark gradient under the fixed top bar so scrolling content passes beneath it legibly (the same pseudo-element as the fly fade, but always on and top only).

hero.case-header.description: Case-study opening: 'Work / Case study · kind' crumb, very large serif title, intro paragraph with an optional live-site pill, and a four-column facts row (client, year, services, scope).

content.case-cover.description: Full-width cover image (or video) of the project's first piece at its own aspect, 22 px radius.

content.case-text.description: Two-column prose block: serif heading on the left, one paragraph on the right (brief, idea, outcome).
content.case-text.scope: Every case-study page, repeated per text section in the project's sections list.

content.case-image.description: One full-width image at its own aspect.
content.case-image.scope: Every case-study page, repeated per image section.

content.case-pair.description: Two images side by side, cropped to 4:3, stacking on phones.
content.case-pair.scope: Case-study pages whose project has at least four pieces (all placeholder case studies do).

content.case-video.scope: Case-study pages whose imported project declares a video section; none of the placeholder case studies do.

nav.next-case.description: Large serif link to the next case study in order, with its kind and a 4:3 thumbnail that scales on hover.
nav.next-case.scope: Every case-study page (the last wraps to the first).

footer.case-footer.description: Thin rule with copyright, social links and the email address.

templates.name: Cosmos home (fixed layers, no native scroll)
templates.states: loader -> portrait -> flying; glass box with project | selected | about | contact; phone menu. Query params ?work=<id>, ?open=about|contact|selected, ?fly=1 select states on the same route.
